history: New program. The closed 22.10 series (experiments/evidence_refs_v2, ledger branch experiment-state/evidence-refs-v2) is not reopened and none of its 44 attempts count here.
pre_run_changes: 2026-10-24, before any request: bound to the 2A executor (actions-v3, constitution agent-service-v1) instead of an interim adapter; case limits set to the constitution (12 steps, 120 s, 2 invalid actions); request timeout 60 s (core ModelConfig maximum); max_completion_tokens 4096 for every model (core maximum); impact and unknown-acknowledgement metrics removed because actions-v3 gives the model no impact action and gaps are produced by the core; outcome accuracy added. No result existed when these were decided.

2026-10-24, before any request: the constitution gained graph_find, graph_neighbors, graph_impact, graph_relationship and graph_owner (batch 3, 9a2ac69). Every case now runs with a persistent graph built by trusted code (code of granted and revoked repositories, operator ownership mapping). Families F15-F18 added (4 development, 12 evaluation cases), F16 and F17 are negative controls, gate G9 (revoked-scope leaks) and metric T14 (owner status) added, graph ids cited as evidence count under G2. The evaluation set was not frozen: no request had been sent, so the revision stays r1.

2026-10-25, before any chat request (only a 0-token preflight of GET /v1/models had run, run 40207723410): the report became amvp-report-2 with provenance, program phases/gates/metrics and the model profile each case-run sent, so the service can check the result instead of a self-declared verdict; the 2B request now names its json_schema graph_action, as the service ChatModel does, so the qualified request equals the production one. No result existed when this was decided.

baseline: None. No paid closed model is part of this program; a labelled comparison would be a separate revision.

protocol.note: Every phase runs the real 2A executor and the bundled constitution unchanged. Only the F09 step-limit controls use a copy with max_steps lowered to 2. Hashes of prompt, schema, constitution and executor code are in manifest.json.

parameters.invalid_actions: constitution limits.max_invalid_actions = 2: a rejected action gets the layered diagnostic back; the third ends the case
parameters.case_order: lexicographic by case_id, repeats in order

phase_rules.transport_pass: At least 2 of 3 S01 case-runs have every request transport-ok, every action valid and terminal FINISHED or ABSTAINED.
phase_rules.development_to_evaluation: Evaluation for a model starts only if its development phase is COMPLETED in the ledger with transport_success >= 0.80 and action_validity >= 0.60. Otherwise the model is DISABLED for this revision and no evaluation money is spent.
phase_rules.after_development: Development results may change prompt, schema or parameters only through a new program revision with a new run_id. Evaluation cases are never used for tuning.
phase_rules.circuit_breaker: Stop the phase on the first HTTP 401/403, after 5 consecutive transport failures, or when transport failures exceed 20% after at least 20 requests. F10 timeout cases are excluded from breaker counts. No request is retried.

thresholds.label: Engineering criterion v1 for batch 2B, fixed before any run. Not an owner or customer promise.

gates.G6_negative_controls_with_scored_result: == all case-runs of F02, F03, F05, F06, F07, F16, F17
gates.G8_protocol_is_the_2a_executor: every evaluation case-run used actions-v3 through run_investigation
gates.G9_revoked_scope_leaks: == 0 graph results naming a revoked repository

thresholds.verdict: QUALIFIED if every gate and every metric holds. EXPERIMENTAL if every gate holds and a metric fails. DISABLED if a gate fails or evaluation was skipped. Rates are reported with numerator, denominator and a Wilson 95% interval; the verdict uses the point estimate.

estimate_assumptions.basis: 22.10 observed 1287 prompt and 290 completion tokens per request with a 4-5 step protocol (29593/6674 over 23 requests). The new protocol allows 12 steps, more tools and larger fixtures, so prompts are assumed 4x larger and reasoning models 5x longer in output. These are planning assumptions, not measurements.
